response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished senior engineer with 16+ years of production software experience and strong TypeScript expertise, he falls significantly short of the minimum 8+ years requirement for building production-grade AI solutions. His recent move to re:cinq and involvement in AI-agent infrastructure (since April 2025) is promising, but after only 4 months, he lacks demonstrated expertise in critical required technologies including vector databases, RAG architectures, LLM optimization, and ML data pipelines. This position requires deep, proven specialization in production AI systems that his career trajectory has not yet provided.
strengths: 16+ years of proven production software development at senior/staff level with strong TypeScript and cloud platform experience
Currently working on AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq with direct involvement in MCP code generators and agentic workflow frameworks
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentorship, and communication abilities across multiple senior roles and technical workshops
concerns: Does not meet minimum 8+ years requirement for building production-grade AI solutions; only ~4 months demonstrated in AI-focused role
No evidence of expertise in required technologies: vector databases, RAG architectures, LLM optimization techniques, or ML-specific data pipelines
Career background is in general software engineering, with no demonstrated experience building, deploying, or optimizing AI/ML systems at scale

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering and TypeScript foundation
Very recent entry into AI domain
